associations.rationale: The formal type characterizes when two ExtMod extensions are equivalent via nonzero-scalar proportionality modulo coboundaries, supporting projectivization but not stating the parametrization or the universal splitting criterion.

The formal type states that one ExtMod extension is equivalent to V × W exactly when its cocycle is a coboundary; this is a splitting criterion for a representative, not the claim that all extensions split iff Ext1 is zero.
